title: Choose Shark's visual world
question: The roll assigned Freight Manifest. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Freight Manifest
options.lineage: ISO shipping containers, port yard codes, bills of lading
options.thesis: Every location is a coded container; every copy or move is cargo in transit.
options.viewport: Standard sidebar, tab strip, address bar and details list; each tab and pinned place carries a container colour block, and a docked manifest strip in the status bar tracks transfers.
options.risk: Turns into a costume if the stencil type or rust leaks past tab codes and the manifest.

raised.raise: Size column draws a fixed log-scale magnitude bar, so big files read before you read numbers.
Nothing labelled twice: toolbar icons drop their captions; names live in tooltips and the command palette.
Density courage: 22pt rows by default, more files per screen than Finder.
Live readout: status bar counts selection, size and free space as you click.
Fixed scale: both split panes share identical row and icon metrics.

options.label: Station Line
options.thesis: The path is a transit line; folders are stations you can ride to.
options.viewport: Address bar drawn as a line diagram with station dots; tabs carry coloured line bullets.
options.risk: Swiss modernism is where most tool redesigns land; it may feel familiar.

options.label: Graphite Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels split by hairlines, with delete set apart from everything else.
options.viewport: Persistent tiled panes; navigation swaps their contents, not the layout.
options.case: Strong product clarity, but it reads as one more dev tool, not as Shark.
options.risk: Dark-only, so it fights system light mode and Explorer users.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Files plotted as stars by magnitude.
options.case: A chart isn't a file list.
options.kept: Fixed magnitude ramp for file size.

options.label: Factory Sleeve
options.thesis: Coded colour strips instead of words.

options.label: Event Catalog
options.thesis: Hundreds of stamp-size cells per page.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Sliders that morph the whole grid live.
options.case: The glyph is the subject there, not files.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Finder and Explorer conventions, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Vibrant sidebar, unified toolbar, list view, accent-blue selection.
